metrics.name: Gross Margin
metrics.formula: If(IsNull([Metrics/Sales Amount]) and IsNull([Metrics/Cost]), Null, Coalesce([Metrics/Sales Amount], 0) - Coalesce([Metrics/Cost], 0))

metrics.name: Private Label Sales
metrics.formula: SumIf(Coalesce([Quantity], 0) * Coalesce([Unit Price], 0) * (1 - Coalesce([Discount], 0)), [Private Label (Product)] = True)

metrics.name: Sales YTD (As Of)
metrics.formula: SumIf(Coalesce([Quantity], 0) * Coalesce([Unit Price], 0) * (1 - Coalesce([Discount], 0)), [Date (Date)] >= DateTrunc("year", [As Of Date]) and [Date (Date)] <= [As Of Date])
